title: On Adopting the new method
subtitle: 社区社会 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）
meta: 主题语境：社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）　|　核心词汇：adopt　|　正文 329 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 adopt 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1980 the grandmother ① adopted the new method without a word of thanks, and every child in the courtyard said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the grandmother ② adopts the new method at once without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ adopt the new method at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ adopted the new method before — a line in the diary for February 1974 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Adopting the new method without a word of thanks, the grandmother said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the lamp at the far window, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ adopt the orphaned child at once, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Adopt the orphaned child at once and never mention it again.

By 1987 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the diary, and a new child from the next courtyard ⑧ adopts the orphaned child without a word of thanks every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the window, said nothing at all; she simply  adopted the new method again when nobody else would.

To adopt the new method, my mother said in 1992, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the courtyard remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the courtyard forgets, somebody adopts the new method at once again and somebody must adopt the new method without a word of thanks all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 采用（一般过去式 adopted the new method：1980 年祖母头一回这样做，不图一句谢）
B. v. 采用（一般现在 adopts the new method：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 采用（不定式 to adopt the new method：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 采用（过去完成时 had adopted the new method：1974 年二月的日记上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 采用（动名词 adopting the new method 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 收养（adopt the orphaned child：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去收养那个没了父母的孩子）
G. v. 收养（adopt the orphaned child：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 采用（后段两处：新来的孩子照例 adopts the orphaned child，而母亲又一次 adopted the new method）

items.q: adopt the orphaned child at once
adopt the orphaned child at once
adopts the orphaned child without a word of thanks

answers.why: adopt 意为“采用”，1980 年祖母不图一句谢采用那套新办法，那是院子里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 adopted。
adopt 意为“采用”，自那以后祖母二话不说地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 adopts。
adopt 意为“采用”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯采用那套新办法”，此处为不定式 to adopt the new method。
adopt 意为“采用”，日记里 二月 那行字说明早在 1987 年之前就有人采用过，故用过去完成时 had adopted。
adopt 意为“采用”，祖母说“采用那套新办法这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 adopting the new method 作主语。
adopt 意为“收养”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去收养那个没了父母的孩子”，should ever 之后用原形 adopt the orphaned child。
adopt 意为“收养”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻收养那个没了父母的孩子（adopt the orphaned child at once），以后再也不要提起。
adopt 意为“采用”，新来的孩子每个年头都照例收养那个没了父母的孩子，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 adopts。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1980 年，祖母不图一句谢采用那套新办法；院子里每一个孩子都说这是头一回。（adopted the new method）
多年以后，祖母仍二话不说地做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（adopts the new method）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯采用那套新办法这件事本身。（to adopt the new method）
早在 1974 年就有人采用那套新办法，二月那天日记上的一行字就是证据。（had adopted the new method）
祖母说过，不图一句谢采用那套新办法这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（adopting the new method 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻收养那个没了父母的孩子，以后再也不要提起。（adopt the orphaned child，祈使句）
answers: In 1980 the grandmother adopted the new method without a word of thanks, and every child in the courtyard said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three years on, the grandmother still adopts the new method at once without being asked.
My mother said later that to adopt the new method at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had adopted the new method long before 1987, and the line in the diary for February proves it.
Adopting the new method without a word of thanks, the grandmother said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: Adopt the orphaned child at once and never mention it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 adopt 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1980 the grandmother adopted the new method without a word of thanks, and nobody in the courtyard forgot it.
Even now the grandmother adopts the new method at once whenever the courtyard asks.
Adopting the new method without a word of thanks, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever adopt the orphaned child at once, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new child from the next courtyard adopts the orphaned child without a word of thanks every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother adopted the new method again, and the courtyard remembered that half.
